result.instructions: Tools for SleekTech, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our properties have a gas safety certificate expiring in the next 60 days?"; "List the open maintenance jobs for the Elm Road flats and their supplier."; "Show each landlord's latest owner statement.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SleekTech data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sleektech_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sleektech_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sleektech_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sleektech_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sleektech_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List properties as a paged list with landlord, status, type, current tenant, monthly rent and arrears. Filter by landlord, status or parent property. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/properties/list.

landlord_id.description: Only properties of this landlord (from sleektech_list_landlords).

status_id.description: Only properties with this status id.

parent_property_id.description: Only the units of this building.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response, for the next page.

tools.name: sleektech_list_tenancies
tools.title: List tenancies
tools.description: List every tenancy across the portfolio (past, present and future) as a paged list. Filter by property, status or date range. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/tenancies/list.

status_id.description: Only tenancies with this status id.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response, for the next page.

tools.name: sleektech_get_property_tenancy
tools.title: Get the current tenancy of a property
tools.description: Get the current tenancy for one property: dates, rent, status and deposit fields. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/tenancies/property/{propertyId}.

annotations.title: Get the current tenancy of a property

tools.name: sleektech_list_tenancy_people
tools.title: List tenancy people
tools.description: List the people on every tenancy in one paged call, with their contact details. Filter by property, tenancy ids or current tenancies only. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/tenancies/people.

property_id.description: Only people on tenancies of this property.

status_id.description: Only tenancies with this status id.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response, for the next page.

tools.name: sleektech_list_landlords

tools.name: sleektech_list_suppliers

tools.name: sleektech_list_staff

tools.name: sleektech_list_maintenance_jobs
tools.title: List maintenance jobs
tools.description: List maintenance jobs across the portfolio as a paged list. Filter by property, landlord, status, open state or date range. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/maintenance/list.

status_id.description: Only jobs with this status id.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response, for the next page.

tools.name: sleektech_get_maintenance_lookups
tools.title: Get maintenance lookups
tools.description: List the values accepted by maintenance writes: 'categories' (with sub-categories), 'statuses' or 'priorities'. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/maintenance/{categories|statuses|priorities}.

tools.name: sleektech_save_maintenance_job
tools.title: Create or update a maintenance job
tools.description: Create a maintenance job for a property, or update it when external_id matches an existing job (upsert). Category and supplier are matched by name; an unmatched name creates a new record. Use sleektech_get_maintenance_lookups first. Nothing is deleted. SleekTech Open API: POST /v1/maintenance.

description.description: The reported issue. Becomes the job title and description.

issue_start_date.description: When the issue started or was reported (ISO 8601).

property_area.description: Free-text area of the property, e.g. Kitchen.

sub_category.description: Sub-category name; used only with a new category.

external_id.description: Your own job id, the upsert key. Avoid the # character.

annotations.title: Create or update a maintenance job

tools.title: List certificates
tools.description: List certificates across the portfolio as a paged list. Filter by expiry or issue date, property or certificate type. Use it to find certificates that expire soon. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/certificates/list.

annotations.title: Get the certificates of a property

tools.name: sleektech_list_certificate_types
tools.title: List certificate types

tools.name: sleektech_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes, tasks and reminders, newest first. Filter by record, assignee, open state or due date. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/notes/list.

assigned_to_id.description: Only notes assigned to this staff id (from sleektech_list_staff).

due.description: true = only notes with a due date.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response, for the next page.

tools.name: sleektech_add_note
tools.title: Add a note, task or reminder
tools.description: Add a note, task or reminder to one record: a property, tenancy, landlord, job, supplier, certificate or expense. Give exactly one record id and the message. Set remind_at to email the assignee. SleekTech Open API: POST /v1/notes.

assigned_to_id.description: Assignee staff id (default: the key's owner).

remind_at.description: When to email the assignee a reminder (ISO 8601; no offset = UK time).

progress.description: Makes it a task with this progress, 0-100.

annotations.title: Add a note, task or reminder

tools.name: sleektech_list_changes
tools.title: List changes since a position
tools.description: List the records created, updated or deleted since your last read. Each event names a type and an entity id; read that record again for its current state. SleekTech Open API: GET /v1/events.

after.description: Event position returned by the previous call (omit for the first call).

types.description: Comma-separated types: properties, tenancies, certificates, landlords, tenancy-people.
